name: Burdock Shelter
titles: Welcome Home, Critter. Come rest with your PNW friends in the rain. 4K, 10 hours
description: Come relax with rain on a tiny camp under a burdock leaf at night, with gentle lofi music and a little campfire crackling. A polyphemus moth, a pygmy short-horned lizard and a northwestern garter snake wait for their soup by the fire, and a western red-backed salamander keeps watch out in the rain with its lantern. All four are native to the Pacific Northwest. 10 hours of 4K, calming ambience with smooth music. Never interrupting with ads.
blurb: I put videos like these on the TV while I work from home, so I started making my own. Each video is one scene I designed for this channel. Excited to continue to develop more.

All my animation is made by myself and rendered frame by frame, and the ambience (rain, wind, the crackling fire and every other effect) is synthesized in my engine. I love making these videos, so please let me know what you would like to see next.
No stock footage, recordings or sound-effect libraries.
